lines.english: Summer is over. Chilly breezes in the morning and evening herald the arrival of the new season.
But fall hasn't started yet. The glaring sunlight at noon rejects the coming of the new season.
"Nee-chan?"
But even during these days of alternating heat and cold, the city slowly loses its warmth day by day.
Yes…
Even the warmth I've held within me since winter, day by day, it goes away.
"I'm opening the door, okay?"
"…What do you want?"
"Oh. You could at least answer me if you're actually in there."
"Of course I'm in here. Did you think I jumped out the window or something?"
"Don't be like that. No one's forcing you to stay in that room, you know."
"But they might as well be."
I've said those ugly words enough times this month to get sick of it.
"So what do you want?"
"Your share of dinner is in the fridge. Mom said you should eat it if you feel hungry.
Oh, and I just watched the news and…"
"I don't need it. Leave me alone."
"How long you plannin' on shutting yourself in…? Everyone's worried about you, Nee-chan."
I've been shut away ever since that day last month… Within the cage of my family's kindness.
My health just never got any better, so I couldn't leave the house even once during the summer break.
Once the summer break was over I did return to work, but this time I'm trying not to overdo it, and I'm avoiding working overtime as well.
My superior accepted it without me even having to explain much.
…Maybe that's just how terrible of a state I was in, and he was simply waiting for me to bring it up.
"Did you take your medicine today?"
"…I'm fine."
"You're fine as in you took your medicine? Or you're fine as in you don't need any medicine?"
"I'm even going to work like usual. I'm perfectly fine."
"But you're like a car without gasoline during the weekends, just like now."
"Well…
Ah, whatever. I'm going to sleep, so just go already."
"But it's only 9 o'clock…"
"I'm going to sleep because you said everyone's worried about my health. Make up your mind."
"…Fine, I'm sorry. Good night then."
The truth is, my current state isn't really that big of a deal at all.
My sudden illness has softened quite a bit since summer break.
Mornings are still a bit of a struggle, but I can get up in time nevertheless.
I'm no longer sweating for no reason, and I can get on the train normally. Neither is it having any noticeable effect on my work.
So there's no problem anymore. Everything's back to normal.
…But those words don't work on my family.
Dad began to oppose my weekend outings.
He said my old symptoms would reappear if I returned to my old habits.
He said that since stress is the cause, the lack of any current stress has led me to mistakenly believe that I'm cured now.
In other words…
Dad believes that the cause of my stress lies in the weekends.
As for Takahiro, he has become really considerate, almost uncomfortably so.
He was always a kind little brother to me, but nowadays he's practically walking on eggshells around me.
He has stopped talking back to me. And our usual fights, big and small, have ceased entirely.
…As a result, we no longer reconcile like we used to. All of our conversations just kind of end awkwardly now.
But the worst reaction is my mom's…
She doesn't reprimand me for my actions, nor does she show any more consideration than she has to; she merely watches from slightly afar.
But then I saw something…
I woke up late at night one day feeling thirsty, so I went downstairs for a drink.
I became apprehensive about going downstairs after that happened, so I barely even leave my room during the weekends…
That's why I can't even go to Minami-Suetsugu anymore, even though it's only one station away.
I left my room making purposely loud footsteps, and when I reached the living room for the first time today, no one was there.
Opening the fridge, I see dinner wrapped in plastic film on the middle shelf. One portion for one person, just like Takahiro said.
But I disregard that and instead reach for my barley tea bottle, still useful even in September.
"Mh…"
I sit down by the table and blow at the barley tea in my cup.
The cold tea permeates my throat to my stomach, causing me a tiny bit of pain.
When I wearily look up at the ceiling, I get the strange feeling that the empty room is quietly laughing at my expense.
"Now's your chance. No one's looking."
"You can leave whenever you want."
"You can go to him again."
And with that, I'm confronted with the reality that I'm deceiving myself.
The reality that my family's behavior is nothing but an excuse.
The reality that my feet aren't moving because I don't want them to. I'm confronted with the fact that I'm the only one responsible for my own fear…
Summer break is over, and so is summer.
Yet ever since I was turned away from Haruki-kun's apartment that day, I haven't taken a single step forward.
I haven't done so not because of anyone else, but of my own free will.
I've been taking advantage of my family's objections, and have willingly shut myself in the cage… no, the protective sanctuary of my home.
The idea of closing the distance between us again, when we've now fallen so far apart is suffocating me.
If I attempt to force things right now, he might only shun me. And I might only shun him in return.
I might hurt him more deeply than I already have. I might get hurt myself once again.
But if I allow us to fall apart like this, he might forget about me and leave me behind. I might forget about him and leave him behind.
He might end up getting even more crushed than he already is right now. But he also might feel a sense of peace by separating from me.
I might be unable to bear the sense of loss if I let go of him. I might be able to bear it, and it'll mark the start of my new life.
…Everything is scaryーso scary.
I love him, and I'm also a burden to him. Both of these things are undoubtedly true.
Then, does that mean that he loves me? Is he a burden to me?
…Can I truly trust him?
Can I blindly follow his lead like "she" could…?
…Is a jealous woman like me even a good match for him?
What about her?
Would the things I'm worried about not even be a small hindrance for her?
Not a matter of what she could do for him, but a matter of what she wanted to do for him. Can I even stand a chance against someone like that?
Can I? Tell me, Kazu…
"Touma Kazusa, taking on the world again."
"Touma Kazusa, the famous pianist who was a sensation in Japan last winter, will finally resume her activities in Europe in earnest."
"Her first performance will be done in cooperation with the Franz Dupre Orchestra."
"The live broadcast of this concert will be delivered to you exclusively here on CS East Asia!"
"Kazusa…?"
"Guess who I just saw on the news…"
"Thank you for your call. This is the Japanese branch of Touma Youko Office PLC."
"I sincerely apologize, but company operations are currently under a temporary hiatus."
"If you have urgent business, please contact the European branch of Touma Youko Office. The number to them is…"
"What's the matter with Miyoko-san?"
I haven't been able to reach her in three months. Did the Japanese branch close or something?
With only a week left until the concert, I've still been unable to talk to Mom.
But it's not like my voice can reach anyone right now…
"Haah…"
The moment I lie down on the bed, an unpleasant sense of fatigue soaks through my body.
My rehearsals with the orchestra only get more and more demanding by the day. I barely have any time to sleep anymore.
…The rehearsals which include me, the conductor, and the strings.
The brass crew were still playing cards in the back, while the woodwinds, slightly more modern, were playing online games on their smartphones instead.
But no one warns them, and no one gets angry.
That goes without saying. This is our fifth full rehearsal, but the time they've spent playing in total is less than an hour.
In truth, no one could complain if they got angry instead and left the project.
What's wrong with this orchestra?
…No, I guess I'm the one holding it back.
"What's the problem then…"
It's not a difficult piece no matter how you spin it. As far as the sheet music is concerned, I haven't made a single mistake.
But this piece is the one my mom played more than any other, always met with thunderous applause in every corner of the globe.
That means there's an important nuance missing in the sheet music.
But that stupid conductor won't tell me what that is. All he does is force repetitions, and he won't let me continue until I've got it perfectly down.
Is he trying to tell me to "listen to my own blood?"
There's only one full rehearsal left.
This is usually the time one would start considering cancellation if things are going this badly.
But this concert isn't going to be canceled, nor is anyone going to lose out because of it.
Because just yesterday, our concert got itself a sponsor.
It's not some local music shop or magazine either, but the same Japanese electronics company that made the smartphone the woodwinds are playing their games on.
Yes, just like the conductor said, this concert has been degraded to nothing more than a faux-concert. "Touma Kazusa-chan's cute little marketing gig."
The moment that piece of news reached his ears, his attitude fully altered course.
Not in the direction of being nicer to me, mind you, nor did he go any easier on me during rehearsals…
"This is amazing! As expected of the Japanese people!"
"To think there are companies willing to throw a fortune down the drain for a mediocre pianist like you…
"I've heard the Japanese are as serious and grave as the Germans, but I can't say I've ever seen a German this generous with money."
"Oh this is just great, please do take all the time in the world."
"After all, even if the concert gets delayed, your excellent sponsor will take the fall for precious little you."
…The only change in his attitude was that he found new and creative ways to verbally abuse me.
Seriously… I know it's only this one time, but why do I have to deal with this guy…?
Your tastes in men are atrocious, Mom…
"Tell me, Mom… Do I really look that unserious when I'm playing the piano?"
"Oh, you noticed? That means you're not satisfied with your own ability as a pianist either."
"Well, I suppose you're right. Right now, the Japanese are about the only ones who'd pay to hear you play the piano."
"Ever since I came to Paris, I haven't been able to converse with my piano properly…"
"Normal people don't do that. It's weird."
"It's just a figure of speech! …I do admit that I'm weird though."
"…So, what is little Piano-chan telling you?"
"The sound of a real orchestra is repelling it… So far, it can only play along with the violins."
"Any clues why?"
"That should be obvious! …It's because you're not there."
"Kazusa…"
"Why aren't you there to protect me? Why are you making me go through this trial?"
"…I'm sorry."
"You don't have to apologize. You only have to be with me… You only have to protect me for eternity…!"
"…I'm so sorry."
That's right… I am weird.
I can't develop bonds with people outside of my own head. I can't talk to the people I love…
Because the people I love, they all leave me sooner or later.
In the end, the only one still by my side is old man Fluegel.
But I can't talk to him right now, because I haven't even told him about Mom's condition yet.
If he were to ever find out that his own protege might pass on before he does, he might lose his will to live.
"I really… don't have any friends, do I?"
I've rejected the world up until now.
Even my mom, even the few people who understood me…
I thought I could stay holed up in this small world forever.
Is this my comeuppance for all those times I tried to make that selfish wish come true?
Not two of us, but three of us… all together…
Is this punishment for betraying the person who said those words to me? The person who tried to become my close friend?
Please…
Someone listen to me. Listen to my words. Listen to my piano.
Tell me I'm fine. Tell me I'll succeed. Tell me Mom will get better.
"Stop it…"
My fingers move on their own.
They're trying to type a number I deleted from my phone ages ago, one that now only exists in my memories.
But this person is out of bounds. I swore I wouldn't.
"Stop it…!"
I promised I would never meet him again, never talk to him again… and never love him again.
I… I…
"Touma Youko Office, European head office…"
The lengthy number written down on a memo pad, with the country code included.
The number robotically recited by the answering machine of the Tokyo branch of Touma Youko Office, the number which I saved a while ago just in case.
Kazusa is working hard…
She's working much, much harder than me…
She's spreading her wings, flying somewhere where people like us can't reach her.
She's going to play with an internationally famous orchestra, on the great stage in Paris.
At a time when I'm unable to stand even on the tiny stage in the local music club…
It's absurd to even compare the two of us, but it's still true that these things are happening at the same time.
…True as that may be, what in the world am I trying to accomplish here?
Why am I trying to get in touch with Kazusa? What would it accomplish to talk to her?
Why would I try to throw this calamity at Kazusa, when she's preparing for her once-in-a-lifetime concert?
I don't know… I don't even know why I'm doing this myself.
But…
Now when I know Kazusa is doing well. Now when I know she's working hard and making something of herself.
Now when Haruki-kun continues to suffer and has been ever since they parted. Now when no one in Japan can save Haruki-kun.
And… now when I'm nearing my breaking point. Now when I'm becoming unable to comfort him…
If the three of us found out about each other's circumstances…
How does she feel about him now?
Is she so immersed in business, success and hard work that she can't even spare a thought for him anymore?
And what does she consider happiness now?
Did fulfilling her lifelong dream of following in her mother's footsteps make her so happy that there's no longer room for any other form of happiness for her?
No, I already know the answer. I can state with confidence.
No matter how famous she becomes, no matter how much the world accepts and loves her…
There really are only a few people Kazusa wants to be loved by.
And being loved by those people is what Kazusa considers the greatest happiness.
Then, perhaps it's really true. If I wasn't there, then…
If only I didn't fall in love with someone I shouldn't. If only I didn't toy with the threads of fate that bound them together…
Would Haruki-kun not have broken down then? Would he have become happy with Kazusa?
What would've happened to me then?
Would I have simply gone on with my life without him?
Would I have found an adequate happiness of my own, surrounded by family, and a slightly different lineup of friends?
And would Haruki-kun and Kazusa be happier than they are now?
Haruki-kun would have stayed his dependable self, and Kazusa would have simply stayed her cute self.
If only I wasn't there, everything would've gone well…
Right before I was about to press the last button.
My cell phone on the table rang out.
"What am I thinking… calling her."
A number I should never be allowed to call. The second worst number to call in all of Japan.
Setsuna's number.
She's living a happy life with Haruki in Japan… They live within society, coming into contact with lots of people.
The number of someone who's the complete opposite of me. Someone who was my close friend… The first person ever to take on that mantle.
Yet I destroyed it. I betrayed herーtwice.
She has the right to curse my name. It's beyond insanity to even attempt to call her.
But despite that…
"Setsuna…"
I want to hear your voice.
I want to relive what we had six years ago.
Even if it's just for a little bit… I want you to share your high spirits, your happiness with me.
You can gush about your love life with him if you want… I wouldn't mind at all…!
But in the end, it was pointless.
Look, she's still not answering.
She's probably long since deleted this detestable number from her contacts.
But even if my name was displayed on her screen…
No, that would be all the more reason not to answer…
"…It's been a while, Kazusa."
"Setsuna…"
What an incredible coincidence.
"You didn't change your number."
"You… didn't delete my number either, Setsuna."
"How could I ever do that?"
"…Thank you."
No, that's not it. The only coincidence about this is the timing.
The two of us exchanging words at this stage of our livesーprobably an inevitability.
"It's really been a while…"
"Yeah… six years, maybe?"
"Yes…"
Come to think of it, last winter…
Whether in Strasbourg or Japan, we never once…
"Ah, but I did go to see your concert. You were amazing during the additional concert, Kazusa."
"…I went to see you live too. Setsuna, you were shining up there."
"Thanks…"
But even that has been lost now. I can't even appear on stage anymore.
There's no shine in me anymore…
"Ah, come to think of it, Kazusa, you're in Paris now, aren't you? That makes it… five in the afternoon, right?"
"Ah, sorry, I suppose it's midnight over there."
"No, it's fine. Today's Saturday, so I'm off work tomorrow."
"I see, that's good…"
"But forget about that, let's talk about Paris! Your concert! What an amazing success, Kazusa!"
I know how clearly the excitement in my voice is slipping out.
But this is wrongーthis shouldn't be happening.
The rift between us will only grow deeper. Our hearts will become more distant.
I can't admit the truth to her like this. I can't talk about what Haruki-kun's going through, or what I'm going through…
"What success? The concert doesn't even start until next week."
You've got it wrong, Setsuna.
Nothing's working out for me right now. I'm about to lose everything I have.
The last leaf is about to fall.
"But aren't you playing with a super famous orchestra? That achievement alone is a big success."
"Their fame means that if I fail, they'll never take me seriously again. You don't know how strict people over here are."
"You'll be alright either way. You can do it, Kazusa…"
"……Don't use those words so lightly…"
"Ah… Sorry. I got carried away…"
What am I doing…?
This is all wrong. I should be the one apologizing, not her.
"N-No… It was my fault, I'm sorry. That was no reason to get angry…"
Do I truly understand just what I've done to Setsuna…?
If I don't apologize, we won't be able to move forward. She won't listen to me. Can't I understand that?
It'll just end as a friendly catch-up about recent events. It won't be anything like the goal I had in mind when I mustered up the courage to call.
So why then would I get angry?
"No… I was being insensitive. I shouldn't have said those words… I'm really sorry."
"Setsuna…"
Besides…
"It's all right. You can do it, Kitahara."
Why is it not just me, but Setsuna who also remembers those words?
"Um, so anyway… Have you been doing well, Setsuna?"
"Y-Yes! I've been really busy recently. No one treats you like a rookie when you're in your second year."
"You're doing public relations for a record company, right? Pretty amazing. That has a pretty high barrier of entry, doesn't it?"
"No, not at all…
Well, I suppose we're a bit understaffed, haha."
What am I saying? Am I an idiot? Have I forgotten the reason why I tried to call Kazusa in the first place?
Now I'm even lying to her. In what way am I even close to doing well?
"Um, so anyway…"
"Y-Yes."
And now I'm not even trying to move the conversation forward.
I know what Kazusa wants to hear from me, but I'm keeping it a secret from her. I'm lying to her…
Why am I not telling her about Haruki-kun?
"U-Um, Setsuna."
"Yes…"
"K-Kazu…"
"I'm sorry…"
"It's absurd that I'm doing this, when I shouldn't even have the right to call you."
"That's not true! I can't think of a single thing you've done that would warrant an apology."
"Setsuna…"
"There's nothing at all…"
I did it again… I messed up again.
I didn't stop Kazusa from apologizing out of any conviction that she was innocent.
I was simply afraid. Afraid that her apology would signify my defeat.
I was afraid because I will be forced to tell her about Haruki-kun…
Even though that was the reason I called her in the first place… Even though my defeat was certain from the start.
But my body freezes in place. Fear stops me from thinking.
Even though going forward might pave the way to a new form of happiness…
For me, for Haruki-kun… and for Kazusa.
But I'm so afraid that it might also lead to a path of ruin, for me alone.
Selfish as always, aren't I?
"I see… Your little brother is in university now. Everyone in the Ogiso household is exemplary as always."
"He's not exemplary at all. He was in Houjou High all this time yet he couldn't get a single recommendation.
"…Is that supposed to be a jab at me? Since I barely made it through graduation, let alone get any recommendations."
"Ah… Now that you mention it, you're right."
"You little…"
"Haha, sorry. Anyway, on to another topic…"
"Yes…"
After that, our conversation stuck to simple and inoffensive topics.
Even when the topic of Houjou High came up, we never mentioned our group study sessions, nor the school festival.
When the topic of my concert came up, I never brought up my mom.
Perhaps it's because we haven't spoken in so long, but I can't sense the distance between Setsuna and me.
…Well, of course I can't. I'm a withdrawn shut-in in my twenties.
What should I do?
I want to… hear about Haruki.
Whether he's happy now, or whether he's working hard. I want to make sure.
I want to talk about… what the real me is going through.
About Mom, my concert, my future… I want her to hear about them, to understand them, even if for a little bit.
That's why…
"Ehm, it's about time to…"
"Eh? Ah, is it this late already? Sorry for yapping on for so long, Kazusa. I know how busy you are right now."
"No… that's not true."
No, it's enough.
If I ask that question, my sin will only reopen Setsuna's wounds.
It would only be running around in circles in the end.
"Thank you, Setsuna. For talking to me out of all people."
I couldn't even let out my frustrations. I couldn't get her to listen to my worries.
I couldn't ask about Haruki. There's been absolutely no progress.
"…Call me again, okay?"
"You too, Setsuna."
"Okay…"
No, that's not true. I did get to speak with Setsuna.
I wasn't able to apologize to her, but Setsuna accepted me nonetheless.
We both kept our masks on, and we weren't able to reconcile. But even then, she did laugh for me.
That's enough for me. That's all I need to keep going starting tomorrow.
"Good night."
"Good night."
So…
No… this is all wrong.
"Setsuna! I'm…!"
"I'm so sorry!"
"I'm so sorry, Kazusa! I don't think I can do it anymore!"
"S-Setsuna…?"
My mind went completely blank.
"I don't think I can save the person we love… I don't think I can save Haruki-kun!"
"Wha…"
I'm not sure what I'm even screaming out right now.
"I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry! You entrusted him to me! You gave him to me! But I can't protect him like this…!"
"Why…?"
But if there's one thing I know for sure, it's this.
If I don't do this now, she'll disappear again.
"Uu, uua… uaaaaaaah!"
"What are you talking about!?"
The goddess who can save Haruki-kun will disappear.
The friend who will show me the path forward will disappear…
"Do you understand? Do you understand just what you've done, Setsuna!?"
"Ug… Uuu… Aaaaah, I'm s-sorry… Forgive me… Forgive me, Kazusa!"
"Do you have any idea how much I've cried!? How much pain I went through to give up on him!?"
"I know that! I know all of that!"
"I did all of that… with the belief that you alone could save him! You and no one else!"
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry! But I've been hurting too! It's been tearing me apart!"
"So you're going to give up!? Are you going to abandon him!?"
"But, but… it all began when you gave up on him! When you let go of his hand!"
"Should you really be saying that!? You were the one who took him first! You were the one who stole Haruki from me!"
What's wrong with this person…?
"What should I do? Tell me, what should I do, Kazusa!? Save me, save me…!"
I always knew this, but this woman is just so selfish…!
"Don't paint yourself as some tragic heroine and ignore everything that's inconvenient! I'm the one who actually needs to be saved!"
"What are you saying!? You're having the time of your life in Europe!"
It really pisses me off.
"Not at all! I have it much harder than you! My mom is… my mom is…!"
I have the life and death of someone I love on my shoulders, and I'm struggling to the death with it…
Yet this person can't even support the one man she loves…
"Uuu… Uaaah… Uaaaaaaah!"
"Again, why are you the one crying, Setsuna!? This has nothing to do with you!"
"B-But…! Your mom… This is so horrible!"
"She's not your mom. She's mine!"
"What are you going to do!? What are you doing!? I don't want this. Why aren't you by her side right now!?"
"Because Mom said she wanted to hear me play. She said she wanted to hear me play the concerto."
"But that's no reason to…! What if you regret this for the rest of your life…!?"
"I'll regret it regardless if I don't play for her. I have to pick one over the other! That's how it always is when it comes to the things I want!"
"…! Are you…"
"It's all… It's all your fault, Setsuna!"
"I don't care! I can't take responsibility for everything! The only one who matters to me is Haruki-kun!"
"So you are taking responsibility! You're not giving up on Haruki at all!"
"Of course not! So you're the one who has to protect your mom!"
"That's not what you said just earlier! Weren't you about to give up on him!?"
"I never said that! I never once said that!"
"Oh yes you did! You said it barely five minutes ago!"
"You have no proof of that!"
"You liar! You coward! You thief! Give him back… Give Haruki back!"
"Now's not the time to be saying that! Why!? Why do we have to end up this way…?"
"Ug, uu… uaaaaaaah!"
"Kazusa, Kazusa…! No… Uaaaah!"
We're justifying ourselves, we're unreasonably lashing out at each other, we're whining, we're pretending not to hear one another, shifting responsibility,
We're…
With no holds barred, we're both using the most despicable ways of arguing among girls.
"Give him back."
"I won't."
"I said give him back."
"Never."
"Can't you see how pitiable I am? Are you so cold-hearted that you can't even feel bad for me?"
"I won't, no matter what you say."
"My concert is right around the corner, and my mom… I'm suffering many times more than you are, Setsuna."
"I'll do anything else for you. I'll even look after her in the hospital, be it in Paris or Vienna if you want."
"Who'd ever want that?"
"But I won't give him back. I'll take back Haruki-kun for myself."
"Are you even capable of that?"
"I am… Even if we separate, even if he abandons me… even if he goes back to you, Kazusa…"
"Even then, I'll turn him back to the old Kitahara Haruki."
"The old… Haruki."
"He's serious, hardworking, preachy… he's a liar, a traitor, cruel… and he's been loving a woman other than me this whole time, but…"
"But it's my natural right as a woman to save the man I love."
"What about my right, then?"
"I'll accomplish that, no matter how much I have to struggle for it. I'll even beg on my knees to my rival in love if I have to."
"…There you go, ignoring me again."
"I'll say it as many times as it takes… I'll do anything else for you, but I'll never give him back to you."
"That's for Haruki to decide."
"Even if you steal him away from me, and he abandons me without a second thought, I still won't hand him over."
"Stop messing around…!"
Damn it…
I've known this for a long time, but she's extremely stubborn.
Really, she's so… strong.
I can only respect her.
"It's about time to hang up, for real this time."
"We talked for quite a while, didn't we…?"
"What time is it right now?"
"I don't know… but it's getting pretty bright here."
"So it must be around four or five?"
"It's ridiculous, isn't it? We're acting like middle schoolers."
Yeah…
We're just like friends in middle school, in love with the idea of being in love, crying together about the boy we have a crush on.
"I'll probably never call again."
"I see…"
Our final, best and worst fight yet, with all our feelings laid bare.
There is no longer anything left unsaid between Setsuna and me.
That's why Setsuna isn't holding back like she usually does.
The two of us will never look up at the same sky again.
"I wouldn't take any of it back. I won't let anyone say a word about us."
"Yes."
"Our decision was ours alone to make. I'm not unhappy. I really do have a lot of regrets, but I wouldn't take any of it back."
"Hang in there… Hang in there, hang in there, hang in there, Kazusa!"
"Don't tell me to hang in there. What if I collapse from overdoing it?"
"Enjoy yourself, slack off, play around, and become the best pianist in the world."
"I can do that without you telling me to. I'll turn into someone you two can never reach."
"Okay!"
